authority: this manifest records what ran; what a run is allowed to claim is still decided by verify/validate_candidate.py

negative_results.detail: build(5,8,3,6) reproduces codes/388-20-5.json exactly: same n=388, k=20, w=4, and an identical permutation-invariant pairwise-intersection signature, so the two differ only in qubit numbering

6 of 6 probed d=4/6/8 configs come back css=False at every pitch: the two-band plaquette colouring that makes the code CSS needs odd d. pitch_min(d)=2*floor(3d/4) was measured at odd d only, so its value at d=6 is an extrapolation and cannot be reached. The d=6 target (required to advance the cell at k>=20) is unreachable in this family.
negative_results.what: even patch size is not in the family

negative_results.detail: rows=2, pitch=2 gives k=2m-1 at n=34m-9 and is CSS with no empty rows, so it screens as advancing at the assumed d=5; measured, all of it is d=4: [(365, 21, 4, 4), (433, 25, 4, 4), (569, 33, 4, 4)]. The bands overlap by seven rows so no patch argument constrains the distance. Reproduces the 2026-08-31 fieldnote's degenerate-mask refutations.
negative_results.what: degenerate overlapping bands collapse the distance
